item.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse Unveiled For Switch, Launching In 2026
item.description: "Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse".As part of the Castlevania 40th anniversary celebrations, Konami announced Castlevania: Belmont's Curse during the latest PlayStation 'State of Play' broadcast.Evil Empire and Motion Twin (known for Dead Cells and The Rogue Prince of Persia) are helping out with the development of the title, and it will be launching for multiple platforms including the Switch in 2026.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Two Legacy Of Kain Titles Are On The Way To Switch 2 And Switch This March
item.description: Including a collection.Crystal Dynamic's Legacy of Kain series will be returning this March with Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered and Legacy of Kain: Ascendance.Both of these titles are coming to the Switch 2 and Switch. Defiance Remastered will be released on 3rd March 2026, and Ascendance is arriving on 31st March 2026.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Surprise! Rayman: 30th Anniversary Edition Arrives On Switch This Week
item.description: Rayman is officially back!Following rumours and a recent rating, we've now got an official announcement! Ubisoft's Rayman is back and he'll be returning in Rayman: 30th Anniversary Edition.This title has been confirmed for the original Switch and multiple other platforms, and the most exciting part is it's out this week on 13th February 2026!Read the full article on nintendolife.com
